description: One failing callback skips later callbacks registered on the same instance and bypasses the list reset.
trigger: Register at least two callbacks on one Cleanupper and let an earlier callback raise during _shutdown.
expected_behavior: Other registered cleanup callbacks still get an attempt when one fails.
actual_behavior: The exception escapes the unguarded loop before it reaches the later callbacks or the reset. In the standalone exit check, weakref reported the exception and continued processing a separate Cleanupper, but the later callback on the failing instance did not run.

verification.description: Registered a raising callback before a marker callback on one transcribed instance and successfully ran the process through normal interpreter exit. The exception appeared, the marker did not, and callbacks on the separate instance ran.
verification.limits: The direct trigger is the new finalizer's call to _shutdown. No repository application callback or entry point was shown to reach it.

introductions.rationale: This commit introduces the unguarded callback loop and puts the list reset after the loop.
